text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan, thanks for giving me that<n>present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was shocked though... You must<n>know your stuff
to find a body mist<n>that fancy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, I wanted to get something<n>special for
the occasion. I had to go to<n>a nice boutique.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, want to go there with me<n>next time?
They have all kinds of<n>interesting things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know it's pretty hard to figure<n>out that stuff,
but maybe we could<n>help each other learn... right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And, hey, if you're there with me, I<n>wouldn't feel
so awkward!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're right. I'd feel better<n>having you with
me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, let's do it! This weekend,<n>we're going
shopping!
